test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - Reasoning(Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Rohit drives 3 km towards north from point A. He takes a left turn and drives 4 km. Again he takes a left turn and drives 6 km. Finally, he takes a left turn and drives 4 km to reach point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Rohit drives 3 km towards north from point A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1736752aa83263f4897751e0d499c4e51a905dd654a83972a5e4bde480b9075d.png] 

2) He takes a left turn and drives 4 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b28d048ed29e6770c64c433e54d69fb05a4b477d3e302a97498041217ced7cd.png] 

3) Again, he takes a left turn and drives 6 km. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e648b1db2cedd519deac439607a00ff724c0c88ac394da911616e547a1902e1b.png] 

4) Finally, he takes a left turn and drives 4 km to reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/410300ace3d1ad28b0b21b157ed80067c87de2e2badcee28b9f6cac7ab5e023a.png] 

Here, we can see that Rohit needs to drive 3 km towards North to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****3 km towards north"**.
